summary: Workspace Architecture Stage 2 - All 16 backend tests passed, all frontend UI tests passed. Workspace selector, workspace settings pages (General/Members/Billing/Discord Apps), and workspace isolation all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Workspace selector correctly shows workspace name with org_count and member_count
Workspace Settings pages use URL-based routing (not internal tabs) - each tab is a separate route
Owner row in Members page correctly hides remove button (is_owner check)
Billing page displays all expected limits (100 orgs, 50 bots/org, 200 discord, 999999 AI messages, 20 custom apps)
Discord Apps page shows Platform Discord App with MANAGED badge and empty custom apps section
Mobile responsive design works - hamburger menu opens sidebar with all workspace controls
Workspace isolation works - both admin@bridgebot.tech (owner) and admin@bitbotpro.io (superadmin) can access workspace settings
AuthContext correctly fetches workspaces on login and scopes org listing with X-Workspace-ID header
seed_data_creation: Test org 'TEST_Org_79_*' created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Workspace Architecture Stage 2 complete. Frontend workspace UI fully functional: workspace-switcher (data-testid), org-switcher, bot-switcher all in sidebar. Workspace Settings routes: /admin/workspace/settings, /admin/workspace/members, /admin/workspace/billing, /admin/workspace/discord-apps. WorkspaceSettings.js uses URL path to determine active tab. Mobile responsive with hamburger menu. Signup workspace auto-creation tested at API level (verification code needed for full flow).
